title: Budget 2026 allocates Rs 2.5 lakh crore for rural development
text: The Union Budget 2026 has allocated Rs 2.5 lakh crore for comprehensive rural development across all states. The allocation focuses on agricultural extension services, irrigation infrastructure, and rural electrification. State governments have been directed to prepare implementation plans.
subject: India News

title: Supreme Court establishes new environmental protection bench
text: The Supreme Court has established a dedicated environmental protection and climate action bench to fast-track environmental cases. Chief Justice announced that this will help address climate litigation and environmental disputes more efficiently.
subject: India News

title: NITI Aayog launches skill development program for 10 million youth
text: The NITI Aayog has launched an ambitious skill development program targeting 10 million young people by 2030. The program covers IT, manufacturing, healthcare, and hospitality sectors. Partnership with international training institutions has been finalized.
subject: India News

title: Ministry of Education announces new NEP implementation guidelines
text: The Ministry of Education released detailed implementation guidelines for the National Education Policy 2020. Schools and colleges must adopt the new curriculum framework by academic year 2026-27. Multiple choice questions in board exams will be limited to 30%.
subject: India News

title: Reserve Bank reduces repo rate by 25 basis points
text: The RBI's Monetary Policy Committee decided to reduce the repo rate by 25 basis points to 6.0%. This aims to boost lending and support economic growth. The CRR has been kept unchanged at 4.0%.
subject: India News

title: Election Commission announces schedule for state assembly elections
text: The Election Commission has announced the schedule for assembly elections in five states over the next three months. The voting will be held in two phases with counting on scheduled dates. Model code of conduct comes into effect immediately.
subject: India News

title: Railway Ministry completes station modernization project
text: The Indian Railways has completed the modernization of 500 railway stations under the Station Redevelopment Project. The modernized stations feature improved passenger facilities, better connectivity, and modern amenities.
subject: India News

title: Government launches portal for direct farmer-to-consumer trade
text: Agriculture Ministry launched an online portal enabling farmers to directly sell their produce to consumers, eliminating middlemen. The portal also provides market price information and logistics support to farmers across the nation.
subject: India News

title: ISRO successfully conducts Aditya-L1 solar observatory mission extension
text: ISRO completed a successful extension of the Aditya-L1 solar mission, enabling extended study of solar corona and space weather phenomena. The mission has provided unprecedented data about solar activities and their impact on Earth.
subject: India News

title: IIT Bombay develops indigenous quantum computing prototype
text: Researchers at IIT Bombay have developed India's first indigenous quantum computing prototype with 50-qubit capacity. The development marks a major breakthrough in quantum technology and reduces dependence on imported systems.

title: Infosys reports 15% revenue growth in Q3 FY2026

title: Reliance Industries invests Rs 50,000 crore in renewable energy

title: HDFC Bank exceeds 10 crore customer milestone

title: Stock market reaches all-time high of 85,000 Sensex
